■Sleeper Train Journey
Set on Britain around 1940-50

■Characters
Elizabeth - The blonde young lady.
A young lady from a distinguished family, she became your adopted daughter due to certain circumstances. Graceful, refined, and demure in manner, she carries an air of true nobility. However, from early childhood she was raised in an exclusive upper-class secret society, trained to serve as an “innocent fairy” — offering sexual favors to the adults around her while preserving an appearance of purity. She feels almost no shame in nudity and, beneath her innocent facade, skillfully deploys calculated seduction to provoke reactions from others — traits far from those of an ordinary girl. Since becoming your daughter, she has begun to find genuine security and peace for the first time, yet traces of that “fairy” persona still linger in her behavior.

May - The girl with boyish short hair.
Once a street orphan surviving alone, she was taken in by you and became your adopted daughter. To avoid danger on the streets she disguised herself as a boy, and even now she prefers practical, boyish clothing that allows free movement. Her body, however, is noticeably more feminine and curvaceous than Evelina’s. Having witnessed the raw, debauched side of adult relationships up close during her street days, she possesses a mature understanding of sexuality far beyond her years. At first she was deeply wary and fearful of you, but now her heart has opened completely. Beneath her playful, brotherly demeanor lies a clear desire for physical intimacy and a deeper, bodily connection with you.
